title: Continue watching across devices
description: Show the same Continue Watching row and resume point on every device signed in to a profile.
evidence: Raised by 9 of 12 interview participants; top theme in September 2026 study

title: Remove from Continue Watching
description: Let viewers remove a title from the Continue Watching row.
evidence: Raised by 5 of 12 participants; 3,100 support contacts last quarter

title: Hide scores on sports replays
description: Spoiler-free cards and thumbnails for live sports replays.
evidence: Raised by 4 of 12 participants; frequent app store review theme

title: Account-level watch progress service
description: Move watch progress from per-device storage to a profile-level service that all clients read and write.
evidence: Technical prerequisite for STR-101, STR-110 and STR-117

title: Pin Continue Watching to the top of Home
description: Keep the row in a fixed position above promotional rows on all devices.
evidence: Raised by 3 of 12 participants; row position varies by device today

title: Profile picker on TV launch
description: Ask who is watching when the TV app opens.
evidence: 4 of 12 participants share one profile across a household

title: Kids profile PIN lock
description: Stop children leaving the kids profile without a PIN.
evidence: Requested in parent survey; no usage data yet

title: Next-episode autoplay countdown redesign
description: Clearer countdown with an easy cancel.
evidence: Usability test: 6 of 8 participants missed the cancel control

title: Multiview for live sports
description: Watch up to four live games on one screen on TV devices.
evidence: Competitor parity; strong interest in concept test (71 percent top-two box)

title: Sync offline viewing progress
description: Progress from downloaded titles updates the profile once the device is back online.
evidence: Raised by 3 of 12 participants, all frequent travellers or commuters

title: Onboarding: pick three interests
description: Ask new subscribers for three interests and personalise Home from day one.
evidence: Subscribers who watch 2+ categories in their first week churn less in the 2025 tip-off cohort

title: Promo step-up reminder and offer
description: Remind promo subscribers before the price steps up and offer an annual plan.
evidence: Cancellations from the NBA tip-off promo cluster in days 27 to 30

title: Search by voice on mobile
description: Voice search in the phone and tablet apps.
evidence: Low volume of requests; parity with TV remote

title: Watchlist sharing
description: Share a watchlist with another profile or household.
evidence: Idea from brand team; no customer evidence yet

title: Accessibility: audio description filter
description: Filter the catalogue by audio description availability.
evidence: Regulatory commitment for 2027; advocacy group request

title: Player performance on older streaming sticks
description: Cut start-up time on low-memory devices.
evidence: Start-up time is 2.4x slower on these devices; correlates with early exits

title: Resume on a different device prompt
description: When a viewer opens the app on a second device, prompt to resume what was playing on the first.
evidence: Extension of STR-101; concept untested

title: Sports hub personalised by team
description: Follow teams and see their games first.
evidence: Top request in sports survey (48 percent)

title: Bundle management in app
description: Let Xfinity customers see and change their bundle from the Stream app.
evidence: 19 percent of billing calls are bundle questions

title: Dark-launch new recommendations model
description: A/B test the new Home ranking model on 5 percent of traffic.
evidence: Offline evaluation shows 6 percent lift in predicted watch time

title: Download quality selector
description: Choose download quality to save storage.
evidence: Common app store request; storage complaints on 64GB phones

title: Live rewind to start
description: Restart a live event from the beginning.
evidence: Competitor parity; rights confirmed for most sports

title: Household viewing report for parents
description: Weekly email summary of what kids profiles watched.
evidence: Parent survey: 34 percent interested

title: Retire legacy TV app (2019 platform)
description: Move remaining users to the current app and switch off the old one.
evidence: Legacy app costs about 1.5 engineers a quarter to maintain; blocks STR-104 rollout on those devices

title: Mark as watched
description: Let viewers mark an episode or film as watched so it leaves Continue Watching.
evidence: Raised alongside STR-102; titles above 90 percent linger in the row
